Outstanding Revisions

Revision 1 · VO Voice

Re-record the narrator with a different ElevenLabs voice — male, American, confident and plain. Same locked script.

In the current cut: The voice was changed, but the wrong way: round 1 sat at a median 122 Hz, round 2 sits at 144 Hz and spends 28% of the take above 165 Hz (round 1: 6%). Higher pitch reads as feminine, so round 2 is further from the brief than round 1 was.

TargetA voice at or below ~120 Hz median — deeper than the round-1 narrator, not higher. In ElevenLabs terms: an American male voice in the mid/low register, not a bright young one.
Check before exportPlay the round-1 narrator and your new take back to back. If the new one sounds brighter than round 1, it’s wrong.
Revision 2 · Hook Ding

Add a ding sound effect on the hook, landing with the arrows.

In the current cut: Not added. The hook audio is unchanged from round 1 (same peaks at 2535 Hz and 6117 Hz) — same mix, just louder. Easy to miss; it needs a real new SFX layer.

Place it on the arrow reveal, around 0:01.0–0:01.5, one ding per name label.
